notes:
REF-BM-04: The API accepts URL changes, but the bookmark editor exposes no URL field.
REF-BM-14: Search does not interpret #tag syntax.
REF-BM-15: Search has simple all/any/exclusion controls but no AND/OR/NOT expression parser, parentheses, or quoted-operator rule.
REF-BM-16: Exact-phrase matching is available only through a checkbox; quoted phrases are not parsed.
REF-BM-20: Bulk add-tag, read/unread, archive, and delete exist, but bulk tag removal does not.
REF-BM-23: Notes support rendered rich HTML formatting, not Markdown input/rendering.
REF-BM-24: No local HTML snapshot or PDF preservation is implemented.
REF-BM-25: No Internet Archive snapshot support is implemented.
REF-BM-29: Saved reusable bundles are not implemented.
REF-BM-30: Netscape import preserves titles, dates, and folder-derived labels but ignores explicit TAGS attributes.
REF-BM-32: Sort preference is persisted, but displayed-item and font-size settings are absent.
